summary.headline: Chapter I: On Nutrition
summary.text: Opening of Albohali’s book on astrological judgments of nativities, followed by Chapter I on nutrition and its indicators: triplicity lords, the ascendant, the Sun, Jupiter, Venus, diurnal and nocturnal planets, and benefic or impeded placements.
